CustomField.description: Reported occupancy percentage of THIS subject asset (e.g., 88.00 for 88%), carried from Lead.Occupancy_Pct__c at conversion. Deliberately distinct from Occupancy_Rate_Market__c, which is the market benchmark (Placer/CoStar lineage) — do not merge these two fields; each captures a different thing.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Carried from the Lead at conversion; null when not stated in the email. Distinct from the Occupancy Rate Market benchmark field.
CustomField.label: Occupancy %
